title.zh: 民族团结、祖国统一与国防外交

clips.send: Macao. Portugal occupied Macao for a long time. It returned in 1999; its Historic Centre is a World Heritage Site.
clips.text: Macao. Portugal occupied Macao for a long time. It returned in 1999; its Historic Centre is a World Heritage Site.

clips.send: Beijing. Capital of China. February 1972: Chairman Mao Zedong met President Nixon here. 2014: Beijing hosted the APEC leaders’ meeting. 2017: the first Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation.
clips.text: Beijing. Capital of China. February 1972: Chairman Mao Zedong met President Nixon here.. 2014: Beijing hosted the APEC leaders’ meeting.. 2017: the first Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation.

clips.send: Taiwan Province. Cross-Strait relations since 1979. The textbook teaches that Taiwan has been part of China since ancient times; the two sides of the Strait have been separated since 1949. 1979: policy of peaceful reunification. 1987: family visits begin. 1992: the “1992 Consensus” on the one-China principle. 2005: Anti-Secession Law. 2008: direct mail, flights and shipping. 2015: the two sides’ leaders meet.

clips.send: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Founded March 1958. The Zhuang are China’s largest ethnic minority. The only autonomous region on the sea coast, next to Vietnam. Famous for the limestone peaks of Guilin.

clips.send: Hong Kong SAR. Returned 1 July 1997. Britain took Hong Kong in stages after the Opium War (1842, 1860, 1898). 1 July 1997: China resumed exercising sovereignty. Hong Kong keeps its capitalist system — “Hong Kong people administering Hong Kong” with a high degree of autonomy. First Chief Executive: Tung Chee-hwa (董建华). The regional flag shows a bauhinia flower.

clips.send: Tibet Autonomous Region. Founded September 1965. The last of the five to be founded. Tibet had been peacefully liberated in 1951. Average height above 4,000 m (13,000 ft) — nearly as high as the tallest peaks of the Rocky Mountains. 2006: the Qinghai–Tibet Railway reached Lhasa.

clips.send: Taizhou. Today: Linhai, Taizhou, Zhejiang. Qi Jiguang’s well-trained “Qi Family Army” beat the wokou pirates nine times in a row around Taizhou.
clips.text: Taizhou. Today: Linhai, Taizhou, Zhejiang. Qi Jiguang’s well-trained “Qi Family Army” beat the wokou pirates nine times in a row around Taizhou.

clips.send: Baimamiao, Taizhou. Today: Taizhou, Jiangsu. The East China Military Region Navy was set up in this small town by the Yangtze — the birthday of the PLA Navy.
clips.text: Baimamiao, Taizhou. Today: Taizhou, Jiangsu. The East China Military Region Navy was set up in this small town by the Yangtze — the birthday of the PLA Navy.

clips.send: Macao SAR. Returned 20 December 1999. Portugal gradually occupied Macao from the mid-1500s. 20 December 1999: China resumed exercising sovereignty; “Macao people administering Macao”. First Chief Executive: Edmund Ho (何厚铧). The regional flag shows a lotus flower.

clips.send: Taiwan. Taiwan has been part of China since ancient times. Two-thirds of the island is mountains; the Tropic of Cancer crosses its middle.

clips.send: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. Founded 1 May 1947. China’s first provincial-level autonomous region — set up two years before the People’s Republic. A long arc of grassland across the north: about 1.18 million square kilometers , bigger than Texas and California together. “Autonomous” means the local ethnic group helps run local affairs, inside one united country.

clips.send: Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region. Founded 1 October 1955. China’s largest provincial-level region: about 1.66 million square kilometers — nearly the size of Alaska. On the old Silk Road, bordering eight countries. Home to Uygur, Han, Kazakh, Hui and dozens of other ethnic groups.

clips.send: Shanghai. China’s largest city. February 1972: China and the US issued their Joint Communiqué here — often called the Shanghai Communiqué. 2001: Shanghai hosted the APEC leaders’ meeting. 2001: the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation was founded here.

clips.send: 香港。鸦片战争后，香港被英国占领。1997年中国恢复对香港行使主权，实行“一国两制”。

clips.send: 北京。中华人民共和国首都。1972年2月，毛泽东主席在北京会见尼克松总统。2014年，亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议在北京举行。2017年，首届“一带一路”国际合作高峰论坛在北京举行。

clips.send: 西藏自治区。1965年9月成立。五个自治区中最晚成立。此前，西藏于1951年和平解放。平均海拔4000米以上，被称为“世界屋脊”。2006年，青藏铁路全线通车，直达拉萨。

clips.send: 台湾。台湾自古以来就是中国的领土。岛上三分之二是山地，北回归线从中部穿过。

clips.send: 台湾省。1979年以来的两岸关系。台湾自古以来就是中国的领土；1949年后，海峡两岸处于分离状态。1979年提出和平统一方针；1987年两岸隔绝状态被打破；1992年达成“九二共识”。2005年《反分裂国家法》；2008年直接“三通”；2015年两岸领导人会面。

clips.send: 广西壮族自治区。1958年3月成立。壮族是我国人口最多的少数民族。五个自治区中唯一临海的，与越南接壤。桂林山水闻名天下。

clips.send: 内蒙古自治区。1947年5月成立。我国第一个省级自治区，成立于新中国成立之前。地域辽阔，横跨我国北部，面积约118万平方千米。在国家统一领导下，各少数民族聚居的地方实行区域自治，设立自治机关，行使自治权。

clips.send: 澳门。澳门曾长期被葡萄牙占领，1999年回归祖国。澳门历史城区是世界文化遗产。

clips.send: 新疆维吾尔自治区。1955年10月成立。我国面积最大的省级行政区，约166万平方千米。地处古丝绸之路要道，与多个国家接壤。维吾尔族、汉族、哈萨克族、回族等多民族聚居。

clips.send: 白马庙。今天：江苏泰州。华东军区海军在长江边的白马庙成立，这一天成为人民海军的诞生日。
